newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: World Bank commends Zimbabwe deficit progress.
newsitem.headline: World Bank commends Zimbabwe deficit progress.

text.p: The World Bank said on Wednesday Zimbabwe had made "some impressive" progress in reducing its budget deficit but said release of crucial balance of payments support would await further progress on the budget.

David Cook, the World Bank's representative in Zimbabwe, told reporters that the bank was also waiting for the government to finalise a new five-year economic reform programme before making this decision.

"We're impressed by government efforts to make sure that the budget deficit goes down. We are impressed by what's going on. One needs to get the deficit down to a level that's sustainable and we're not yet there," he said at the end of two-day annual aid talks.
The talks culminated in an agreement between the two parties on a standard development aid programme aimed largely at reducing poverty in the southern African country.
